reviews.title: App completely non-functional
reviews.text: I don’t know what happened, but when I opened the app today, the little shot trail animation came up and the screen went to just all white.  No options to see the schedule, the leaderboard, etc.  Just nothing.  Tried reinstalling the app, but same results.  This happens on both the iPad and iPhone versions.  I hope it is just their servers, not the app itself.

reviews.text: This app is trash. It's the US Open and no shot tracker. They show Rory on 18 and he's doing a TV interview AFTER he signed his card. Just like NBC, they need to up their game!

reviews.title: SLOWWWWWW!!!!
reviews.text: I like this app to check out the leaderboard when I can’t watch the tournament. However, it’s agonizingly slow, taking 20-30 minutes to update scores. I don’t know how the organization that literally controls the events can’t create an app update scores faster.

reviews.title: Late
reviews.text: The leaderboard is consistently behind the real-life pace by multiple holes. It can take up to 30 minutes for new data from the course to be reflected on the PGA Tour’s official leaderboard, both on the app and the website. This is inexcusable when the Masters has a much better and faster app even though it is only used for one weekend out of the entire year.

reviews.title: Broken all around

reviews.title: Updates are a joke

reviews.title: PGA Tour vs LIV Tour
reviews.text: I do not think any of the LIV players should be able to play in any of our PGA tournaments like the Major tournaments. They are no longer a member of the PGA Tour. I wish they would consider changing this.

reviews.title: Slow Score Updates
reviews.text: The app has a lot of great features, I love the overview of the holes, and looking up stats, but what I mainly use the app for is for score updates. Unfortunately within the past few months the score updates have gotten incredibly slow, at least two holes, if not 3 holes behind real time events. I’ve tried restarting the app and other troubleshooting, but it appears to be an issue with the app itself. Shame.

reviews.title: So LATE!!
reviews.text: I’ve never seen such a lame sports app from a “real-time” perspective. Baseball and football apps provide every pitch or snap asap. This app runs SO behind the live event. Sometimes it takes 20 minutes to have the correct scores on the leaderboard. Just unreal.

reviews.title: Leaderboard Lag

reviews.title: Why so far behind?
reviews.text: I like all the features but leaderboard is about a half hour behind! Sometimes I see spelling errors in golfer names. Otherwise, it’s easy to use. I do wish I could customize my view.

reviews.title: Slow opening
reviews.text: It takes a long time to open the app on my iPad. The content is good once inside but getting it open is very frustrating. It becomes my last choice for tee times or leaderboards.

reviews.title: Horrible App for iPad
reviews.text: It’s official now that I have deleted this app from my iPad! It has gotten worst! It’s great for a phone but iPad forget it! The format does not work on an iPad. The home page at the top used to have a video, but could only see half of it, now it is blank and just blinks and never downloads. There are other issues but would take to long to tell you. I have the GolfChannel app now and it works! GolfChannel has great features! Maybe you should ask them how to make a format work for all iPads, phones etc. I gave a one star only because your app actually works for a iPhone. I don’t understand how the GolfChannel, ESPN, etc can have their apps work for all platforms but you can’t!? Get it together PGA and get it fixed!

reviews.title: Good App Mostly
reviews.text: Like the app for most of its purpose.  Somehow the sort on the round scores is messed up.  Rather than sorting with minus scores at the top and highest positive scores at the bottom, it sorts Even to Par scores, then negative, and finally positive scores.

reviews.title: App not Opening
reviews.text:
After downloading an update to the PGA Tour app earlier today, it doesn’t launch. I rebooted my iPhone, but still it doesn’t launch. Updated version downloaded, but still the app doesn’t launch (iOS 16.17.4) This problem still exists. Please fix it. Sent emails to PGA HQ, but the same silent response as writing a review of the app. The PGA Golf developers are obviously not interested in resolving issues in reviews written by users of their app. Despicable if you ask me!!!

No action translates into “Can’t be bothered about addressing the issue of the app not loading.” You ought to be ashamed!

reviews.title: PGA Tour App not Launching
reviews.text:
I use an iPhone 8 and the software version is iOS 16.7.15 which cannot be upgraded further. This iPhone model is no longer supported, having reached the end of its iOS support life cycle. This software functioned perfectly with your app until the latest upgrade to version 2026.2.6. So it looks like my software is no longer compatible with the PGA Tour app version 2026.2.6? Please confirm.

I received the following response from the development team “Please update the Operating System to 17 or higher on your iPhone.” If you were to read my earlier post you will notice my software version is iOS 16.7.15 which cannot be upgraded further i.e. my phone has reached the end of it’s iOS support life cycle. So I can’t upgrade my iOS version. If this means I can no longer use the app, then so be it.
